name: Alameda County Property & Salvage Donations
description: Free surplus office furniture for County-contracted nonprofits, plus low-cost surplus sales open to the community
fullDescription: Alameda County's General Services Agency donates surplus office furnishings from its Property & Salvage warehouse to qualified nonprofits that contract with the County to provide community services. Other nonprofits and the public can buy surplus items at low prices.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free in-kind donations of surplus office furniture for qualified nonprofits
- Low-cost surplus and gently used office furniture for sale ("pennies on the dollar")
- Warehouse shopping Thursdays and Fridays, 9 am-3 pm (closed 12-12:30 pm)
- Availability varies based on county surplus
howToGetIt:
1. For free donations, your nonprofit must be in contract with Alameda County as a provider of community services
2. Call the Property & Salvage office to request a donation
3. Or visit the warehouse on Thursday or Friday to shop surplus items for sale
4. Arrange pickup of approved or purchased items
keywords: Alameda County, surplus property, nonprofit donation, free furniture, office equipment, electronics, 501c3, government surplus, in-kind donation
